notes: Project scaffolded via `npm create vite@latest stitchsmith -- --template react-ts`.
Vitest is the planned test runner; install with the React Testing Library preset.
shadcn/ui components are copy-in via `npx shadcn@latest add ...` — not npm packages.
Tailwind v3 is planned; revisit if shipping with v4 at scaffold time.
Greenfield: build/test commands assume standard Vite/Vitest scripts will be present in package.json after scaffolding.

infrastructure.hosting: Static hosting (Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages) — fully client-side SPA
infrastructure.network: Standard — no backend, no required network after page load except asset fetching

additional_services.storage: Browser LocalStorage for working project state; JSON import/export for backups and sharing
